errors.text: The proposed alloying element and its concentration are unspecified, so the intervention is not operationally testable.
No prior evidence is cited to support stabilization by negative mixing enthalpy.

The mechanism addresses bulk phase separation only and does not address the target instability mechanism of rapid, shape- and size-dependent Au/Cu surface segregation, melting, evaporation, and particle reshaping.
The experiment lacks defined exposure temperatures, dwell times, atmosphere, heating rate, quantitative thresholds, and direct elemental-diffusion or surface-segregation measurements.
